title: 2006 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: The letter T is formed by placing two \(2 \times 4\) inch rectangles next to each other, as shown. What is the perimeter of the T, in inches?

solutions.text:
If we found the total perimeter of the two rectangles separately, we would have gotten \[ 2(2(2 + 4)) = 2 \cdot 2 \cdot 6 = 24. \]

In the letter T, we can see that their intersection removes a piece of length \(2\) from each of the rectangles. Therefore, the perimeter of the T is \[ 24 - 2 \cdot 2 = 20. \]

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Start with the perimeters of the two rectangles separately.
The shared interior segments are counted in the separate perimeters but not in the outside perimeter.
